binding_definitions.terminal_correct: At episode exit, known=True and last active semantic bound_goal_index equals scored goal_index and declared label equals requested label. No success, stop, pose, or drop predicate is used.
binding_definitions.ever_correct: At least one actually applied reorient_target/verify_target/stop action binds the scored physical goal and requested label, regardless of subsequent inspect, wrong binding, drop, abstention or success.
binding_definitions.terminal_unbound: No current binding: initial state or cleared by an actually applied inspect_face.
binding_definitions.drop_after_binding: A drop does not clear outer evaluator binding variables. A correctly bound trial dropping before stop would count as terminal-correct and ever-correct but failed, unless a later applied inspection had already cleared the terminal binding.
binding_definitions.unapplied_responses: Replies without applied_step never change binding, even if saved after episode termination and containing a target-binding proposal.
binding_definitions.recognition_limit: Applied binding is a semantic action declaration, not an independent human recognition or visibility annotation.

scope: Hashes reference original files; sanitized files intentionally have different hashes. Compact offline recomputation does not replace the full physical-trace audit.
exclusions: Engineering and smoke attempts are excluded, including an earlier failed admission HTTP 504. All 80 formal episodes and all their returned calls are included.
